_note: A second fictional demo company (Vietnam Google AI Builder Furniture) that makes furniture in Vietnam for the United States: onboarding answers, About company profile, suppliers with their documents, sites, 16 orders and 4 playbook rules. Loaded by `python -m app.seed_demo_data --company us-furniture --email <another user>`. Each supplier's documents are chosen against the US checklist in reference.json; the seed analyses the orders, so each status is what that checklist gives (exposed = a document missing, not the accepted standard or expired by the ship date, or no supplier record, as for Hiep Phuoc Rattan). Coordinates are [longitude, latitude]. Province names follow Vietnam's July 2025 mergers.

company.description: Vietnam Google AI Builder Furniture makes indoor and outdoor wooden furniture in Dong Nai, Vietnam, for US retailers and online furniture brands. We buy rubberwood, plantation acacia, hardwood plywood and cabinet carcasses from Vietnamese suppliers, assemble and finish in our Nhon Trach factory, and ship full containers from Cai Mep to US West and East Coast ports.

rules.text: Flag any order where the projected margin drops below 10% after US duties.
Recheck the Section 232 rate on every upholstered seating and kitchen cabinet order that ships on or after 1 January 2027.
Never ship hardwood plywood to the US without the supplier's core-veneer origin certification on file.
Give Long An Panel Co. until 30 November 2026 to send a TSCA Title VI certificate.
